themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are ramping up organizational machinery, selecting lead candidates, and contesting mainstream electoral strategies. From AfD party congresses in Germany to Vox challenging PP's 'useful vote' tactic in Spain and LLA consolidating legislative alliances in Argentina, right-wing movements are positioning themselves for decisive shifts ahead of upcoming elections.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Campaigns intensely across regions while Abascal explicitly rejects PP's 'useful vote' rhetoric to capture disaffected voters.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Convenes party conventions to elect lead election candidates and solidify goals for sole governance in key state polls.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Maneuvers ahead of the 2027 presidential race while securing required sponsorship pledges.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Karina Milei leads high-level political coordination to unify legislative strategies and negotiate electoral alliances with PRO.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Pushes for electoral pacts and target by-elections to counter polling slumps and challenge Labour dominance.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polls show presidential contender Karol Nawrocki surging as a leading conservative figurehead for future elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Peter Magyar and Tisza Party escalate parliamentary pressure and public media reform battles against established leadership.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures are escalating demands for strict border controls, immediate deportations, and explicit 'national priority' policies in housing and public benefits. Rhetoric advocating 'remigration' and restricting state aid exclusively to native citizens is migrating rapidly across European party platforms.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal and local candidate platforms openly champion 'remigration' and national priority for Spaniards in local services.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Party leadership calls for large-scale deportations of up to 2.6 million foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes outright bans on foreign graduates receiving student loans and demands tighter rules on migrant welfare.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes for aggressive EU-level exceptions and hardline domestic migration policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local officials advocate strict conditionality for municipal assistance and immigration cutbacks.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and media outlets are highlighting legal proceedings, state surveillance, and judicial rulings aimed at conservative leaders. Coverage ranges from Jair Bolsonaro's hospital custody amid a 27-year sentence to leaks investigations surrounding Rassemblement National and court injunctions halting MAGA policy directives.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonaro remains under intensive care and police custody following emergency surgery, as supporters denounce his 27-year sentence.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Focuses on state investigations involving leaks of confidential interior ministry files to party leadership.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Engages in sharp conflicts with the ruling coalition over judicial authority and Constitutional Tribunal control.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Federal judges issue rulings blocking administration executive orders on homelessness and federal projects.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are placing economic populism at the center of their domestic messaging, promising targeted tax cuts, welfare redistribution for families, and pension modifications. These proposals serve as key leverage points to critique ruling coalitions and appeal to working-class demographics.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Unveils a national housing program requiring commercial banks to include 800+ child benefit payments when calculating creditworthiness.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Navigates national union strikes against the 2027 draft budget while advancing targeted tax relief for youth and Superbonus tweaks.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Debates internal shifts on retirement policy between lower age thresholds and mandatory capitalization funds.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei defends strict deregulation and anti-inflationary policies as essential for long-term fiscal stability.

themes.title: Gamified Pop-Culture Tactics and Digital Propaganda
themes.blurb: Right-wing administrations and political movements are increasingly blending political communications with video game references, viral stunts, and celebrity endorsements. By leveraging internet culture and high-profile tech figures, these movements seek to bypass legacy media channels and mobilize younger audiences.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Federal departments post social media graphics referencing video game franchises like Grand Theft Auto to frame policy stances.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei highlights high-profile endorsements from Elon Musk and Cybertruck appearances alongside comedic viral video stunts by party allies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Party leadership figures feature heavily in mainstream pop-culture parodies and viral entertainment broadcasts.
